timothy1.4.p1.b1.text: Now the Spirit expressly states that in later times some will abandon the faith …

timothy1.4.p1.b2.text: They will prohibit marriage and require abstinence from certain foods that God has created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

timothy1.4.p1.b3.text: For every creation of God is good, and nothing that is received with thanksgiving should be rejected,

timothy1.4.p1.b4.text: because it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.

timothy1.4.p2.b1.text: By pointing out these things to the brothers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, …

timothy1.4.p2.b3.text: For physical exercise is of limited value, but godliness is valuable in every way, holding promise for the present life and for the one to come.

timothy1.4.p2.b4.text: To this end we labor and strive, because we have set our hope on the living God, …

timothy1.4.p3.b2.text: Let no one despise your youth, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.

timothy1.4.p3.b3.text: Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to exhortation, and to teaching.

timothy1.4.p4.b1.text: Do not neglect the gift that is in you,

timothy1.4.p4.b2.text: which was given you through the prophecy spoken over you at the laying on of the hands of the elders.

timothy1.4.p4.b3.text: Be diligent in these matters and absorbed in them, so that your progress will be evident to all.

timothy1.4.p4.b4.text: Pay close attention to your life and to your teaching. Persevere in these things, for by so doing you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
